description: Add a card to a deck, incrementing its quantity (creates the row if absent). Use set_deck_card_quantity to set an absolute quantity or remove_deck_card to delete a row. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

deckId.description: Deck id. Get from list_decks or create_deck.

isSideboard.description: Whether the card belongs to the sideboard. Mainboard and sideboard are separate rows. Defaults to false.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

name: add_deck_card
